*Julia Lawson*  [9:46 PM]
Hey, guys. We just finished talking with [PERSON_NAME_0029]. And basically:

• Don't use Domino Delights documents for Zombie Match features, please. The system can be the same but There are nuances that create edge cases. For example, with daily login, because we don't have a queue manager yet, he had to do something else with the animations and that was one of the issues in the last week's meetings. 
• Because [PERSON_NAME_0029] tends to do small tasks and they can be popping in and out, he struggles with prioritization. Please take extra care with his tickets and consider his other tickets when you set priority for a new ticket.
• Engineers struggle when documents are incomplete in quantity, a simple reward on our document can mean a bigger task on the client or backend side we can't anticipate as designers, so please make sure your documents are completed in this regard before you kickoff a feature.
• We did remind him we expect documents to be a guide of its own without additional tickets. So let's make sure our documentation is complete at best we can.
I sent this to the design team, [PERSON_NAME_0029]. We'll try to do better by you, and I think I made my concerns clear too. I'm sure we'll do better moving forward.

Hey [PERSON_NAME_0040].. I didn't quite get the first thing about daily login..  what I mentioned is that when we implemented that from DD, we didn't have it integrated in backend so that took extra effort to make it work and by that time we didn't have defined which kind of reward we'd obtain because we were using the other document as reference.

and I mentioned the queue manager should be something to consider for later once we add these reward animations, because it'd happen some things overlap if There're some pop up screens, I can't guarantee it was just a guess I said that could happen in the future.
For the rest I'm agree, we'd give feedback if we notice stuffs are missing to you guys to take as consideration on the document.
It's just as an example so I think it's okay if the situation isn't exactly that all the time.
The main thing is the documents and the tickets right?
